questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What is the most prominent difference between male and female mosquitoes?
A. Their antennae
B. Their wing shape
C. Their legs
Answer: A. Male mosquitoes have feathery, bushy antennae that help them detect the wingbeats of female mosquitoes for mating. In contrast, female mosquitoes have more plain antennae.
questions.de: An welchem Körperteil unterscheiden sich männliche und weibliche Stechmücken am deutlichsten – bei den Männchen ist es buschig und federartig und hilft, den Flügelschlag der Weibchen zu hören?
questions.en: Which body part most visibly tells male and female mosquitoes apart, being feathery and bushy in males and helping them detect the wingbeats of females?

timeline.labelEn: Christopher Johnston describes the hearing organ in the antennae of the Culex mosquito (Johnston's organ)
timeline.labelDe: Christopher Johnston beschreibt das Hörorgan in den Antennen der Culex-Stechmücke (Johnston-Organ)

questions.notes: Timeline from Wikipedia 'Johnston's organ' (Johnston 1855, 'Auditory apparatus of the Culex mosquito').

questions.cardText:
[Botany] Which of the following plants is mainly pollinated by bats?
A. Durian
B. Orchid
C. Pitcher plant
Answer: A. Durian flowers bloom at night. The nocturnal flowering attracts bats, which feed on the nectar and, in turn, pollinate the flowers.
questions.de: Welcher südostasiatische Fruchtbaum mit stark riechenden Früchten hat nachts blühende Blüten, die vor allem von Fledermäusen bestäubt werden?
questions.en: Which Southeast Asian fruit tree, known for its strong-smelling fruit, has night-blooming flowers pollinated mainly by bats?

timeline.labelEn: The durian is scientifically named Durio zibethinus
timeline.labelDe: Die Durian erhält den wissenschaftlichen Namen Durio zibethinus

questions.notes: Bats pollinate the common durian (Durio zibethinus); a few other Durio species are bird- or bee-pollinated. The authority for the 1774 name is disputed between Linnaeus and Murray.
